changelog:
claude-handoff 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Claude Handoff skill.
- Generates a structured handoff package when local agent determines cloud Claude Code is needed.
- Supports user review and manual approval before any Claude Code invocation; never auto-invokes Claude.
- Triggers on hard gates (e.g. iOS .swift files), escalation score, build failure, low reflection confidence, or explicit user request.
- Summarizes context, rationale, proposed plan, local attempts, and provides ready-to-run Claude commands.
- Helps users control Claude Max quota usage with clear cost estimates.
